description: This file is a Lua module that tracks garbage collection of tables. It defines functions to start and stop the tracking process by setting a metatable with a __gc metamethod that marks collection events for further processing.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Begins the tracking process by setting a metatable with a __gc metamethod and creating an initial object.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops the tracking process and triggers a final garbage collection cycle.
